description: Defines the Loop class for managing event loops with thread-local lazy initialization, callbacks, and integration with uSockets library.

classes.name: Loop
classes.description: Manages event loop creation, callbacks, and thread-local storage for asynchronous operations.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the thread-local singleton instance of Loop, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the loop, including timers and underlying native loop.

methods.name: addPostHandler
methods.description: Adds a callback to be invoked after each event loop iteration.

methods.name: removePostHandler
methods.description: Removes a previously added post-iteration callback.

methods.name: addPreHandler
methods.description: Adds a callback to be invoked before each event loop iteration.

methods.name: removePreHandler
methods.description: Removes a previously added pre-iteration callback.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Schedules a callback to be executed on the loop's thread.

methods.name: integrate
methods.description: Integrates the loop with external event loops (e.g., Node.js).

methods.name: setSilent
methods.description: Sets the loop to silent mode, suppressing certain markings.
